card.name: Khanjluri
card.profile: Khanjluri is a competitive war-themed dance in which shepherds dressed in red chokhas compete in dagger skills and complex movements, one performer replacing another to showcase courage and skill (Wikipedia; Sukhishvili). The Sukhishvili repertoire describes it as a dance depicting warriors' descent from the mountains with swords and knives, where dancers compete in rapidly performing the most complex feats. Because it involves daggers and knives thrown into the air, spun and used in combat-simulating maneuvers, it demands exceptional practice and precision (iberogeorgia).
card.insight: Khanjluri turns the Georgian warrior ethos into a wordless dialogue of dexterity and bravado, symbolizing the passing of martial tradition between generations; the name derives from 'khanjali' (dagger).
card.image_significance: Shepherds duel with daggers. A representative image shows upright carriage, sweeping arm lines and embroidered dress — Georgia.
